title: Functional Genomics of Human Brain Development and Disease Conference
level: Scientists and graduate students (bachelor's degree in science/engineering required)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Functional Genomics of Human Brain Development and Disease" will take place from 21 to 26 March 2027 in Ventura, United States. Applications must be submitted by 21 February 2027 through the conference page on grc.org.
requirements: Undergraduates or those without a bachelor's degree in science/engineering (or acceptable equivalent) are not eligible to apply (GRC policy)
